Amazon fixtures added 2026-09-13 from the PO's second handover package; the search page's session values were redacted on 2026-10-22, the product page is unmodified.

facts.redacted: Redacted 2026-10-22 in place (the handover's capture had carried them since 2026-09-13; earlier versions remain in git history): the proxy's anonymous Amazon session id in every encoding it appears in, every anti-CSRF and validation token, a hashed session id, the encrypted slate token and the ad pixel's a2= visitor id, replaced with zeros or REDACTED. fixtures.why: the barcode is published under "Global Trade Identification Number", NOT "UPC" — the handover's own findings claim every page uses "UPC", and this page is the counter-example. Kept at full size because its 16 incidental "UPC" strings are what the noise control asserts against
